steps.name: Step 1 — Open the pipeline; it loads in Flow view
Step 2 — Locate the Flow/Yaml toggle group above the canvas
Step 3 — Click "Yaml" button; the YAML editor view activates

Step 5 — "Copy yaml code to clipboard" button is visible
Step 6 — YAML content contains entry_point, nodes, and state keywords
